critique: The clean cyan-on-black wireframe style and recognizable pyramid geometry match the intended abstract geometric treatment well. Motion from t1 to t4 is outward, and individual forms are clearer than in prior iterations. However, the group remains concentrated in a small central region: at t4 several pyramids still converge through the same center and form a tangled cluster, while most of the frame stays unused. The intended result needs a wider field of separated, individually readable pyramids rather than a compact central burst.

suggestions.why: Increase particle travel distance so the pyramids occupy a substantially broader portion of the frame by t4 instead of remaining centered.
Reduce simultaneous pyramid count slightly so the expanded field retains distinct pyramid silhouettes instead of intersecting at the common center.
